## Scope reviewed

List the specification, changed files, relevant tests, and environments used.

## Acceptance results

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AC-01 | Pass / Fail / Blocked | Test, observation, screenshot, or file reference |

## Requirements trace

Confirm that every requirement is implemented and covered by an acceptance
criterion. Report untested or extra behavior.

## Judgment review

Assess customer comprehension, evidence integrity, language quality,
accessibility, privacy, failure clarity, and other non-automated criteria named
by the spec.

## Checks run

List each command or manual procedure and its result. Do not claim a check was
run when it was inferred or skipped.

## Findings

List concrete deviations in priority order with file references where
applicable. Distinguish a spec failure from an optional improvement.

## Verdict

Choose one:

- **Pass:** all required criteria pass.
- **Pass with founder-approved exception:** name the exception and decision.
- **Fail:** list the bounded changes needed before re-verification.
- **Blocked:** name the missing evidence or environment.
